text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's it for today's training.
Thank you for your hard work!
Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
More, even more...!
I can still jump higher...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! Hey! If it isn't Dants!
Are you done for today?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Tap-chan, are you gonna keep going?
You've been at it forever... Are you holding up okay?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's no biggie! Total breeze!
If it's for the sake of winning, this is only natural, right?
choice_data_list: Do you already have a specific race in mind?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and a pretty massive one at that!
If we win, all eyes will be on us... It's a sign pointing to riches.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Enough to build an entire castle! Haha, gets you pumped up, doesn't it!"
choice_data_list: You really want to win that race, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to win... Ha!
Well, you're not wrong, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"To me, victory is just a means to an end!
I'll win, make a name for myself... and take everything!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now, hoist the sails!
Romance is—just on the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Can I stick around and do some
independent training after this?!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Stamina-wise...
it's pretty tough, though!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Winning as a means, as a dream...
Tap-chan's scale is just so huge...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it made me feel
so terribly small.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: “Even so, against amazing girls like them... I still want to win!”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to everyone, it might be tiny, but...
I'll do whatever it takes to catch up!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: So... please!
choice_data_list: Got it! Go ahead and give it your all!
Let's take today off and try again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame runs toward the setting sun. ...Her dazzling brilliance made me narrow my eyes just a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Effort is all about steady, consistent progress.
I explained this to Dantsu Flame,
along with the dangers of overworking.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
True, that's right...
I'm sorry for making such unreasonable demands.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to get plenty of rest today,
and tomorrow, the day after... I'll keep giving it my all!
